description: Every distinct IPC/BNS/IT-Act section found in data/firs.json, stored in UPPERCASE (uppercase the FIR's section before lookup, e.g. 'BNS 305(a)' -> 'BNS 305(A)'), mapped to the likely crime types from the taxonomy. A single FIR may carry multiple sections; sections alone do not determine crime type — narrative context is required.

sections.description: Common intention — criminal act done by several persons in furtherance of the common intention of all
Snatching — punishment for snatching (theft by sudden or forcible seizure)
Theft in a dwelling house — theft in any building, tent or vessel used as a human dwelling or for custody of property
Extortion — punishment for extortion (putting a person in fear to dishonestly induce delivery of property)
Cheating — cheating and thereby dishonestly inducing delivery of property
Cheating by personation — punishment for cheating by pretending to be another person
House-breaking by night — lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night in order to commit an offence punishable with imprisonment
Cheating by personation using a computer resource or communication device
